title: Docunivo | Free Online OCR & Document Tools
heading: Free online OCR and document tools
description: Extract text from images, convert image tables to Excel, scan PDFs, organize receipts and remove photo backgrounds with Docunivo's browser tools.
intro: Turn images and scanned documents into text you can use. Docunivo brings image to text, image to Excel, receipt to CSV, PDF OCR and background removal together in your browser.
details: Start with the image to text tool above, or choose another converter. Review recognized text and table cells before copying or downloading. Your selected files are processed on your device; engines and AI models download on first use.

title: Image to Text Converter - Free Online OCR | Docunivo
heading: Image to text converter
description: Convert JPG, PNG and screenshots to editable text with free online OCR. Crop, rotate and recognize English, Hindi, French or Spanish text in your browser.
intro: Copy text from a picture without retyping it. Use this image to text converter for screenshots, photographed notes and printed documents in JPG, PNG, WEBP or BMP format.
details: Upload an image up to 12 MB, crop or rotate it, then choose English, Hindi, French or Spanish for OCR. Edit the recognized text before copying or downloading a TXT file. Clear printed text works best; handwriting and complex layouts may need corrections.

title: Image to Excel Converter - JPG & PNG Tables | Docunivo
heading: Image to Excel converter
description: Convert a JPG or PNG table into editable spreadsheet cells. Review OCR results, repair rows and columns, and download Excel XLSX or CSV in your browser.
intro: Turn a photographed table or spreadsheet screenshot into editable cells. The image to Excel converter uses OCR to rebuild simple rows and columns from JPG, PNG, WEBP and BMP images.
details: Review the beta's detected table, insert or delete rows, split or merge columns, and export XLSX or CSV. Blank cells are retained. Merged cells, skewed photos and complex tables can need manual repair; the output does not reproduce the original formatting.

title: Receipt to CSV Converter - Receipt OCR | Docunivo
heading: Receipt to CSV converter
description: Extract items and totals from English receipt images. Review quantities and prices, add receipt details and export the edited data as CSV or Excel.
intro: Use receipt OCR to turn an English receipt photo into a table of items, quantities, prices and totals. Review the result before exporting receipt data to CSV or Excel.
details: This beta supports English receipts with decimal-point amounts. Enter the date and currency, repair detected items, and confirm your review before export. Unsupported lines stay available for inspection. Automated checks help spot mismatches but do not replace checking the original receipt.

title: PDF OCR Online - Extract Text from Scanned PDFs | Docunivo
heading: Extract text from scanned PDFs
description: Recognize text from scanned PDF pages with online OCR. Choose pages, review the result and copy or download TXT. Files are processed in your browser.
intro: Extract editable text from scanned PDFs without uploading the document to a Docunivo server. Choose the pages to recognize and use English, Hindi, French or Spanish OCR.
details: Upload a PDF up to 30 MB and process up to 20 selected pages per run. Review each page's text before copying or downloading TXT. This tool extracts text; it does not create a searchable PDF or preserve page formatting. Start with a few pages on devices with limited memory.

title: Free Background Remover - Transparent PNG | Docunivo
heading: Remove image backgrounds online
description: Remove a photo background and download a transparent PNG. Preview cutout edges with different backgrounds. AI processing runs on your device.
intro: Remove the background from a photo and save a transparent PNG cutout. Preview the result on a checkerboard or solid color before downloading.
details: Upload a JPG, PNG or WEBP image up to 12 MB. The first use downloads the AI model, and processing runs on your device. Large images are resized to a maximum 2048-pixel edge. Hair, glass and complex scenes can need extra editing. Preview colors do not change the transparent download.
